policy.summary: Static creator-selected trading fee charged through hook deltas, with zero native LP swap fee.
policy.formula: ratePips = hookFeePips; feeRaw = floor(feeBearingAmountRaw * ratePips / 1000000). The fee-bearing amount is the specified request or executed unspecified amount according to direction, amount mode and fee currency mode.

hookFeePips.description: The creator-selected constant trading rate in fee pips; 1000000 pips represents 100% of the fee-bearing amount.

minimumHookFeePips.description: Frozen constructor lower bound that must not exceed hookFeePips; it does not change the static trading rate.

feeSensitivityPipsSecondsPerTick.description: Frozen uint32 constructor input, including zero; unused by this static policy.

oracle.description: No oracle history is maintained or read for fee calculation. The base still validates the configured oracle factory and registration configuration.

behavior.warmup: No oracle warm-up; the configured static rate applies once the inherited lifecycle permits trading.
behavior.flatOrFalling: Price movement does not change the rate.
behavior.idle: Elapsed time does not change the rate.
behavior.zeroSensitivity: No effect; sensitivity is not used by the static rate calculation.
behavior.zeroMaximum: hookFeePips zero requires minimumHookFeePips zero and produces zero trading fees.

risks: External LPs receive no native swap-fee allocation from this zero-LP-fee policy; pool donations are a separate mechanism, not an automatic share of hook fees.
Positive rates can round to zero fees on sufficiently small raw amounts.
A nonzero PoolManager protocol fee makes the inherited hook reject swaps.
Complete inherited runtime and dependency review, author authorization and registry admission remain separate from these declarations.
